title: Baked Mediterranean Chicken with Apple
description: A flavorful and healthy keto dish with the sweetness of apple and the tanginess of Mediterranean spices.

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh herbs such as parsley, cilantro, or basil

instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and Mediterranean spice blend.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, diced apple, and chopped tagine.
Add the chicken breasts to the bowl and toss to coat with the apple and tagine mixture.
Transfer the chicken breasts to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
